messages:
zoe_cs: Heads-up: Equinox renewal stuck. Procurement requires invoice to reference customer's vendor wallet ID (VW-6042) and insists subsidiary sign first. They say their AP won't accept anything else. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
martin_sales: Do we have precedent for adding a vendor wallet ID on invoice PDF? I thought we only support PO numbers and tax IDs.
harper_finance: We can add an extra reference field on the invoice PDF for "Vendor Wallet" but need legal to approve changes to invoicing terms. Also note: adding the wallet ID means ops will route payment to a different ledger tag.
sylvia_legal: Quick template tweak is fine, but we should have a clause in the statement that invoicing to alternate wallet does not change payment terms or liability. I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum.
equinox-procurement (quoted): "Invoice must show VW-6042 and we require the regional office CFO to sign prior to parent procurement. AP will not process without wallet reference on the PDF."
zoe_cs: Customer wants kickoff next week; enablement is waiting on a single signed PDF that includes VW-6042. Any way to expedite?
harper_finance: If legal can add addendum quickly and we create a DocuSign envelope with signing order (subsidiary, parent, Redwood), we can generate the invoice PDF immediately after signature. Ops will accept the vendor wallet field.
martin_sales: I'll nudge the buyer. @equinox-procurement can you confirm wiring will still go to the parent treasury if the wallet ID is listed on the invoice?
equinox-procurement (quoted): "Yes, wiring goes to parent treasury. Wallet ID is internal routing only."
sylvia_legal: Drafted addendum and added: "Supplier may reference a customer-specified Vendor Wallet ID on invoice PDF; such reference is for customer internal routing only and does not alter payment beneficiary, currency, or terms." Uploading to DocuSign now.
deploy-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.example.com/envelopes/equinox-9057  signing order set.
zoe_cs: Great. Finance to confirm invoice template; legal to confirm clause; sales to confirm buyer signoff.
harper_finance: Confirmed we can populate VW-6042 into the invoice reference area and keep beneficiary wiring to parent.
martin_sales: I emailed buyer with the envelope link and asked for expedited subsidiary signature.
zoe_cs: Action items: Sylvia finalize envelope, Harper update invoice template, Martin confirm buyer. If signed today we can keep the onboarding slot.
all: :thumbsup:
(END)
